notes: Darwinbox candidate board. The listing request is POST /ms/candidateapi/job/alljobs?companyId=main with JSON {companyId, page, sort_option:'new', limit}; the observed unfiltered request carries no filter keys. The company config enables department, location, experience, employee_type, functional_area, capability, job_tags, country and job_title filters, and POST /ms/candidateapi/job/newfilters returns their options. That filter endpoint returned a Cloudflare challenge to this worker, so native filter parameter names are not documented; the scraper applies keyword/location/department/employment_type/country locally.
